title: Hearty Homemade Canadian Chickpeas Skewers
description: A nutty and snappy Canadian dish featuring chickpeas, perfect for a diabetic-friendly meal, grilled to perfection on a robata grill.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium-high heat, around 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chickpeas to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread 4-5 chickpeas onto each wooden skewer, leaving a small space between each chickpea.
Place the skewers on the robata grill and cook for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally.
Cook the chickpeas until they are lightly charred and crispy on the outside.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the chickpeas skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
